answer: Reputation decays exponentially with a fixed half-life, so influence must be renewed through sustained, reciprocal honest service; a burst of endorsements cannot preserve it. In the EigenTrust matrix, a freshly spawned sybil has no trusted path and therefore near-zero eigenvector centrality, while reciprocity-weighted transitivity limits collusive amplification, leaving its consensus signal below threshold. A sybil named sable, spawned at dawn, must still earn trust over time.
